opportunities.title: Source Verified Fusion 360 CNC Data
opportunities.description: We are looking for CNC machine shops and authorized manufacturing data suppliers who can provide original files from real, previously completed 3/3+2/4/5-axis CNC milling jobs using Autodesk Fusion 360 CAM. All parts must have been physically machined in actual production. We are not looking for newly created designs, simulated CAM projects, or regenerated G-code. Compensation: -3-axis machining -3+2-axis machining -4-axis machining -5-axis machining Required Files per Part Please refer to the attached sample package. 1. 3D Model: Original part model (STEP or equivalent). 2. Fusion 360 CAM/Mastercam File: Original .f3d/mcam file containing the model, machining setups, tools, and toolpaths. 3. Actual Machine-Run G-code: Original CNC programs used during production, covering every setup or clamping operation. 4. 2D Production Drawing: Original drawing with dimensions and tolerances (PDF or DWG). 5. Part Information: Material, machine make/model, controller, shop location, and relevant production details. Data Ownership & Authorization All files must come from genuine, completed production jobs. The machine shop must own the files or have explicit permission from the rights holder to share and license them. We do not accept confidential, NDA-restricted, export-controlled, or unauthorized customer files. Shop and customer information will be handled under the agreed confidentiality and data-use terms. Paid Pilot & Ongoing Opportunities - Initial Pilot: 5 real CNC-machined parts from the same machine shop. - Pilot Payment: Quality Review: Files must be complete, original, consistent, and verified against our requirements. - Ongoing Work: Additional batches of approximately 20 parts, depending on data availability and successful QC approval. We are interested in long-term partnerships with reliable CNC machine shops and authorized suppliers. Who Should Apply? - CNC machine shop owners or managers - CNC production teams using Fusion 360 CAM - Authorized representatives with access to genuine archived manufacturing data - Manufacturing data suppliers working directly with verified CNC shops How to Apply Please briefly confirm: 1. Do you have access to real, previously manufactured 3-axis CNC milling jobs using Fusion 360 CAM? 2. Can you provide the original CAM files, production drawings, and actual machine-run G-code? 3. Do you own these files or have authorization to share them? 4. Can you supply 5 qualifying parts from the same shop for the initial paid pilot? Important: This is a manufacturing data sourcing project, not a CAD design or CNC programming job

opportunities.title: Zerodha Kite Breakout Options Bot
opportunities.description: I need a streamlined trading bot that hooks directly into Zerodha Kite and executes a pre-defined options strategy—no outside alerts, no manual pushes. The logic is simple and fully rule-based: when price breaks out above a user-set range the bot buys a call; when it breaks below, it buys a put. Everything else (symbols, range parameters, lot size, stop-loss/target if required, and trading window) should be modifiable from a small config file or GUI so I can tweak the settings without touching the code. Here’s what I’d like handed over: • Clean, well-commented source (Python preferred, but I’m open) that authenticates with Kite Connect, listens to live ticks, detects the breakout, and places the corresponding market or limit order. • A compact module encapsulating the breakout calculation so I can reuse or extend it later. • Basic logs of every trade (time, symbol, side, quantity, entry price, exit if you code one). • A short README with environment setup, API key placement, and run commands. Keep the design lightweight and stable—no heavy frameworks—so it can run on a low-cost VPS during market hours. Once the core is working, I’m happy to test with my sandbox credentials and then switch to live.

opportunities.title: Diseño Arquitectónico y Estructural 3d para Casa Progresiva en México
opportunities.description: Se requiere el diseño a medida de una casa habitación en México, con un enfoque en la progresión futura. El proyecto incluye la creación de planos arquitectónicos detallados, una solución estructural completa (zapatas y castillos) que permita el crecimiento a una segunda planta en el futuro, y un modelo tridimensional de la vivienda. Inicialmente, la casa será de una sola planta, pero es fundamental que el diseño estructural esté completamente calculado y preparado para soportar una segunda planta sin modificaciones mayores en la estructura de carga existente. La distribución de la planta baja debe incluir dos recámaras, un baño completo, y una sala y cocina integradas en un concepto abierto. Además, se debe contemplar desde esta fase el espacio y la ubicación idónea para un futuro cubo de escaleras que no interfiera con la estructura de carga. El terreno total mide 50 x 40 metros, pero que quede suficiente espacio para crecer en un futuro igualmente a los lados Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Arquitectura Tamaño del proyecto: Medio

El proyecto incluye la creación de planos arquitectónicos detallados, una solución estructural completa (zapatas y castillos) que permita el crecimiento a una segunda planta en el futuro, y un modelo tridimensional de la vivienda. Inicialmente, la casa será de una sola planta, pero es fundamental que el diseño estructural esté completamente calculado y preparado para soportar una segunda planta sin modificaciones mayores en la estructura de carga existente. La distribución de la planta baja debe incluir dos recámaras, un baño completo, y una sala y cocina integradas en un concepto abierto. Además, se debe contemplar desde esta fase el espacio y la ubicación idónea para un futuro cubo de escaleras que no interfiera con la estructura de carga. El terreno total mide 50 x 40 metros, pero que quede suficiente espacio para crecer en un futuro igualmente a los lados Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Arquitectura Tamaño del proyecto: Medio"
requirements_list: Habilidades exigidas por el solicitante: Arquitectura, AutoCAD, Modelado 3D, Análisis Estructural, 3d, Animación 3D.
Presupuesto publicado por el cliente: USD 100 - 250.
Competencia actual en el anuncio: Propuestas: 5.
Entregar avance inicial rápido y archivos editables según lo descrito en la solicitud textual.

opportunities.title: Build n8n Automation Portfolio Case Studies
opportunities.description: Here are your n8n projects, based on what you’ve told me. I only list what you’ve actually described, so add real numbers (leads, time saved) wherever you can. Numbers make a portfolio far more convincing. Upload these first (strongest for the jobs we discussed) 1. Instant AI callback and lead update pipeline (ITM) A lead requests a callback, and an AI voice agent (OmniDimension / Bolna AI) calls them instantly and answers their questions. When the call ends, an n8n webhook sends the call to an LLM, which marks the lead interested or not interested. An API call updates the lead stage in Customer.io, which triggers the next action. Runs on about 1,000 to 2,000 leads per day. Tools: n8n, Customer.io, OmniDimension, Bolna AI, LLM. 2. ICICI SRM AI calling agent pipeline n8n reads data from Google Sheets, generates each agent’s configuration with Gemini (structured output parser), and creates the agent through the OmniDimension REST API. Agent settings: ElevenLabs voice, Deepgram transcriber, GPT-4o-mini, webhook callback, human transfer number, and Hindi persona rules (correct feminine verb forms). Afterwards you analysed call transcripts and sorted leads into hot, eligible and callback-needed groups. Contact enrichment through the Lusha API. 3. Lead data pipeline into Customer.io (BBA leads) An n8n webhook receives lead data, normalizes it, and forwards it to Customer.io. You also built daily lead tracking by querying Customer.io directly. 4. “Shruti” voice agent for MCA lead follow-up Designed on OmniDimension for follow-up calls to MCA programme leads. Strong supporting projects 5. Nexi, the AI course generator (versions 1.0 to 4.0) Built in n8n with OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Ideogram and Kling. Show how it improved across four versions, since that shows you iterate. 6. LMS content generation system n8n orchestrates the Claude API to produce structured JSON for MongoDB-backed course sessions (track, module, topic, with text, section and media blocks). Optional HeyGen and ElevenLabs for media. 7. Academic Feedback Dashboard Weekly WhatsApp feedback collection from students through Interakt, orchestrated by n8n, stored in a database with a dashboard on top. 8. WhatsApp AI chatbots for ITM Deployed across several business units with CRM integration, using Meta WhatsApp Business API. 9. Bulk email workflow n8n sends email through SMTP with Google Sheets as the data source, with batching. Not n8n, but worth including as full-stack proof Placement Radar: Next.js, MongoDB, job scraping with Apify, AI relevance filtering, lead tracking, round-robin assignment, WhatsApp and email communication. Admissions analytics schema and omnichannel dashboard: lead source tracking, funnel timing, payment tracking, with Looker Studio and Power BI dashboards. Which to upload for which job Job Upload Voice AI right-hand (solo founder) 1, 2, 4, then 3 Lead Recovery Engine (US real estate) 1, 3, 8 AI business automation (healthcare, AU/NZ) 1, 7, 9, plus the analytics dashboard Before you upload Confidentiality: ICICI is a client programme, and the others involve students’ data. Describe them as “a banking-sector training programme” or “an education company”, remove names, phone numbers and screenshots with real data, and use dummy data for demos. Check you’re allowed to share workflow files at all, because exported n8n workflows can contain credentials. Remove all API keys and webhook URLs before exporting. For each project, add: the problem, what you built, the result (even a rough number), and the tools. Four short lines are enough. I haven’t seen the workflows themselves, so I can’t describe node-level details. If you paste a workflow’s JSON with credentials removed, or describe how one works, I can write a precise case study for it.

opportunities.title: Premium B2B App & Admin Platform
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced UI/UX designer and app developer to build a premium B2B mobile app for OFF SCRIPT GROUP, with iOS and Android versions and a web-based admin dashboard. Our company has five divisions: 1. BRANDS — Showcase our brands and receive distributor or stockist applications. 2. SOURCE — Customers submit sourcing and manufacturing requests, including product references, quantities, specifications and file uploads. 3. DESIGN LAB — Showcase our portfolio and accept briefs for brand identity, packaging and product design. 4. DISTRIBUTION — Wholesale product catalogue where customers select products and quantities and submit orders. 5. INVESTMENT — Present partnership opportunities and receive confidential business proposals and pitch decks. Main features: • A polished homepage introducing the group and its five divisions. • Customer registration, login and company profiles. • Product catalogues with images, specifications and search/filter options. • Order submission and repeat orders. • A private customer area to track orders and projects, view updates, download documents and approve designs. • Email and WhatsApp contact buttons for each division. • Notifications for project updates and approval requests. • An admin dashboard to manage products, customers, enquiries, orders, projects, files and access permissions. Important: This is a B2B platform. Do not display product prices or include online checkout/payment processing. Customers submit orders or enquiries through the app; our team confirms details, quotations and payments through email or WhatsApp. Design direction: premium, modern and distinctive, using black, ivory and electric blue. Our existing OFF SCRIPT logo must remain unchanged. I have visual references to share. Please quote separately for UI/UX design and development, with clear milestones. Include your proposed technology, timeline, relevant portfolio, ongoing running costs and maintenance options. The deliverables must include editable design files, full source code, documentation and assistance publishing under our company’s Apple and Google developer accounts.

opportunities.title: Smart Hydroponics System Integration
opportunities.description: I am the founder and project owner of an ongoing project called **Smart Hydroponics – Smart Hydroponics Urban Gardening using AI**. The objective is to develop an intelligent, automated and scalable hydroponic farming system that combines embedded electronics, IoT, artificial intelligence, automation and software development. The system is designed to monitor and manage hydroponic growing conditions, automate essential farming operations, analyse plant and water conditions, and provide intelligent recommendations through an integrated software platform. The project is already under development, and I am looking for experienced individuals who can help complete, integrate, test and optimise the existing system. ## Work Required I am looking to hire professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas: 1. Embedded Systems & IoT Engineering - ESP32-S3 firmware development. - Sensor integration and calibration. - pH, EC/TDS, dissolved oxygen, water temperature and level monitoring. - Environmental monitoring, including temperature, humidity, CO₂ and light. - Relay control, automated pumps and nutrient dosing. - Offline automation and IoT communication protocols. 2. PCB & Electronics Design - Circuit design and verification. - PCB design using KiCad. - Power management and protection circuits. - Sensor interfaces and modular hardware architecture. - Hardware testing and troubleshooting. 3. Flutter & Backend Development - Flutter application development. - ESP32 and mobile application integration. - Supabase authentication, database and cloud synchronisation. - Dashboard, sensor monitoring and historical analytics. - API integration and system reliability. 4. AI & Intelligent Automation - AI-powered crop recommendations. - Water and nutrient analysis. - Plant health and disease detection. - Predictive maintenance and automated decision-making. - Yield prediction and sustainability analytics. 5. UI/UX & Touchscreen Integration - 10-inch touchscreen dashboard. - Real-time monitoring interface. - Farm management and automation controls. - Integration with the existing software architecture. Please provide: 1. Your technical skills and area of expertise. 2. Relevant previous projects or portfolio. 3. Technologies, tools and frameworks you work with. 4. Estimated time required for your assigned work. 5. Your expected project-based or milestone-based charges.

opportunities.title: ISO 27001:2022 NABCB Certification Support
opportunities.description: Looking for ISO 27001:2022 Freelancers / Consultants – NABCB Accredited Certification We are Souveno AI, a Hyderabad-based technology startup, looking to obtain ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification under NABCB accreditation. Our Requirements: Company size: 1–5 employees. Certification scope: Sowi (Vision AI) and EtoD (Business Automation). Implementation approach: Hybrid, with internal work and external expert support. Total budget: ₹50,000 (including implementation and certification). We are Looking for the Following Freelancers: 1. ISO 27001 Implementation Consultant: Risk assessment, ISMS documentation, policies, asset register, Statement of Applicability (SoA) and implementation guidance. 2. ISO 27001 Internal Auditor: Internal audit, gap assessment and certification readiness. 3. NABCB-Accredited Certification Support: Assistance with the genuine certification process, including Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits. Preferred: Someone who can independently handle the complete implementation and coordinate the certification process within our budget. Alternatively, freelancers who can handle individual tasks at an economical price. Important: The final certificate must be issued by an active NABCB-accredited certification body for ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Freelancers cannot independently issue this accredited certificate. If you have relevant experience and can complete the work within our ₹50,000 total budget, please contact us with your experience, approach and quotation. Location: Hyderabad (Remote collaboration is acceptable).

opportunities.title: Modern Everyday Jewellery Collection
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a cohesive line of everyday fashion jewellery and need a creative partner who can take my ideas and translate them into production-ready designs. The collection will cover rings, necklaces, pendants, earrings and bracelets, with the rings leaning toward a minimal, modern aesthetic—clean lines, subtle textures, nothing overly ornate. For the other pieces I’m happy to explore complementary styles that still feel lightweight, wearable and contemporary. What I need from you is the full design package: concept sketches that show the overall look, accurate 3D CAD files (Rhino, Matrix or similar) ready for prototyping, and high-quality renders so I can present the range to manufacturers and retailers. Please include basic material specifications and stone sizes where relevant so everything can move straight into sampling once approved. When you respond, let me know how you normally structure your workflow from mood-boarding through to final CAD, and share a few examples of minimal or fashion-forward pieces you’ve designed before. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit.

opportunities.title: Luxury Villa False Ceiling Design
opportunities.description: I have a 10,000 sq ft villa that now needs a complete set of false-ceiling drawings prepared in AutoCAD so the contractor can move straight into installation. The overall mood of the house is high-end, so every ceiling should feel luxurious and cohesive from the foyer through to each bedroom, lounge and corridor. The concept must integrate these lighting elements: • Hidden LED strip lighting • Spotlights and chandeliers • Cove lighting with decorative panels What I expect from you: full-size CAD plans, relevant sections and details that show exact levels, framing and cut-outs for the luminaires above. Indicate fixture schedules and switching zones directly on the layout so the electrical team has zero guesswork. If you already use standard layer naming conventions, please keep them; otherwise match the simple scheme I will supply once we start. Files should be delivered in DWG (2018 or earlier) with all external references bound and fonts embedded. A quick PDF set for review before final submission will help us lock the design early and avoid site delays. If you have prior villa, hotel or high-end retail ceiling work in your portfolio, that will give me confidence we can finish this quickly.

opportunities.title: Custom Suit Embroidery Design
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a tailored suit line and need a fresh, polished embroidery design that can be stitched cleanly onto clothing pieces—primarily jackets, shirts, and the occasional cap. Here’s what I have in mind: • A distinctive “suit embroidery” motif that captures a refined, modern look while remaining easy for an embroidery machine to render. • Final files supplied in a common machine-ready format (DST or PES preferred) plus the working vector (AI, PDF, or SVG) so I can resize without losing quality. • A quick mock-up on a jacket front or sleeve to confirm placement and scale before you generate the stitch file. Acceptance criteria – Smooth, continuous paths with no jump stitches that could cause thread breaks. – Thread color chart included. – Design stitches out cleanly on a medium-weight wool swatch in a single hooping. If you’ve created clothing-focused logos or monograms before and know your way around Wilcom, Hatch, or similar digitizing tools, your experience will be invaluable. I can turn feedback around quickly so we stay on schedule.

opportunities.title: Enhance Beyblade X Toy Parts
opportunities.description: I’m expanding my Beyblade X line and need a toy designer or mechanical engineer who can hunt down off-the-shelf components—or refine the ones I already have—so the finished top delivers much stronger attacks and impacts in the arena. I’m not starting from scratch; basic shells and molds are on hand, but the weight disks, attack rings, and performance tips need an upgrade in materials, geometry, or both. What I’d like from you is practical, production-ready guidance: research compatible parts, suggest modifications, then supply CAD files or clear technical drawings that slot straight into the existing Beyblade X system. Familiarity with injection-molded ABS, zinc alloy rings, and the standard Takara Tomy sizing conventions will make the job smoother. I have SLA and SLS printers for rapid prototyping, so designs that can be printed and battle-tested quickly are ideal. Deliverables • Parts list with supplier links or machining specs • Updated 3D models (STEP/STL) showing precise fit with current shells • Short performance brief explaining how each tweak amplifies attack power while preserving balance • Simple assembly guide for factory tooling We’ll iterate after each prototype test until the hit strength and spin stability reach the target. If you work in Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or similar, that’s perfect—just be sure the exports open cleanly. Let’s craft a top that sends competitors flying.

opportunities.title: Product Demo Reel SaaS Builder
opportunities.description: I am creating a SaaS that automatically turns user-submitted assets into short, polished product-demo reels. The service must ingest common inputs (screen recordings, logo/brand kit, captions), stitch them together with clean transitions, on-screen call-outs and background music, then render ready-to-share MP4 or vertical formats suitable for stores, landing pages and socials. Key expectations • Cloud-based architecture that scales; a REST/GraphQL API so other apps can trigger reel generation • Templating logic to overlay feature highlights, animated text and end-cards • Fast rendering pipeline—FFmpeg, Remotion, or comparable video-processing tech is fine as long as it outputs consistently high quality • Modern, minimal web UI for users to upload assets, preview and download completed reels • Deployment scripts and concise docs so I can maintain and extend the platform Please include links to past work that proves you have shipped similar automated video or SaaS products. I will shortlist based on real examples of previous builds, clean code structure and an eye for smooth motion design.

opportunities.title: Automated AI Job Search Assistant
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a lightweight AI-driven tool that takes the grind out of job hunting. The core workflow I need is simple: • It scans LinkedIn, Indeed, and individual company career pages on a schedule I can set. • For every new posting it checks title and location, then dives deeper into required skills, experience, salary range, remote-friendliness, and contract type to decide whether the role is a true fit. • When a match is confirmed, it stores the posting in a local database (or Google Sheet) and—once I give the green light—fills out and submits the application automatically, uploading my existing résumé and pre-written answers where applicable. I’d like the matching rules and application details to be editable in a simple settings file or control panel so I can tweak keywords, locations, salary thresholds, and form-field mappings without touching code. A brief set-up guide and a short screen-share hand-off will be enough documentation. Deliverables 1. Source code (Python preferred, Selenium/Playwright or similar) with clearly commented sections for matching logic and form automation. 2. Config file or UI for adjusting search and application parameters. 3. Demo video or live walkthrough proving it can: – discover a new posting on each of the three target sites, – classify it correctly, – auto-populate required fields, and – submit the application error-free. If you’ve built scrapers, browser automations, or ATS integrations before, this should be straightforward. Let me know what libraries or headless browser stack you prefer and how quickly you can turn around a functional MVP.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40798307, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 400 - 750.

Social media and content ● Plan and manage the content calendar across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and other channels ● Work with the Design Manager on content briefs, production, and timelines. ● Publish organic posts, engage the community, and track performance. 2. Campaigns and paid ads ● Plan and run organic and paid campaigns on all platforms. ● Set up, launch, and optimise ads directly in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. ● Manage budgets, targeting, creatives, and A/B tests, and report on ROI and CAC. 3. SEO and GEO ● Build keyword strategy and on-page SEO for the website and tour pages. ● Grow our visibility in AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity (GEO). ● Track rankings, traffic, and organic growth. 4. Platform growth (prime objective) ● Work with the founder on campaign strategies to attract Travel Personas, Hosts, and Maestros. ● Run outreach, partnerships, referral programmes, and onboarding campaigns. ● Track the acquisition funnel and hit agreed growth targets. Key KPIs ● Follower growth and engagement rate ● Ad performance (CPL, CAC, ROAS) ● Organic traffic and keyword rankings ● New Travel Personas, Hosts, and Maestros onboarded through social media campaigns Profile ● 3+ years in social media or growth marketing, ideally in travel, marketplaces, or startups. ● Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, and SEO tools. ● Data-driven, creative, and comfortable working in a startup.

opportunities.title: Hand-Drawn Storytelling Animator Needed
opportunities.description: I already have a polished script and a final voice-over track for a series of character-driven YouTube videos. What I need now is a skilled 2D animator who can translate that narrative into a rich, detailed hand-drawn world. The focus is pure storytelling with expressive characters, cinematic scene transitions, and smooth lip-sync that matches my audio perfectly. You will receive: • the complete script • the mastered voice-over file • timing notes for key story beats From there, your task is to animate the characters and scenes so the visuals carry the same emotional weight as the dialogue. I welcome whichever tools you prefer—Toon Boom, TVPaint, Adobe Animate, or another hand-drawn pipeline—as long as the final render looks authentically illustrated and is delivered in 1080p (or higher) ready for YouTube upload. Deliverables • Finished 2D animation video, synced to my voice-over • Source project files and layered artwork • Up to two minor revision passes to fine-tune motion or timing If you have a reel that highlights narrative pieces in a hand-drawn style, that will help me gauge fit quickly. Let’s turn this script into an engaging animated story my subscribers will remember.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40798291, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 37,500 - 75,000.

opportunities.title: Premium Cybersecurity Tri-Fold Brochure Design
opportunities.description: Create an ultra-professional, premium, modern tri-fold brochure for a Cybersecurity and IT Security Company. Company Name: CYBER SHIELD TECHNOLOGIES Main Headline: "Protecting Your Digital World" Tagline: "Your Security, Our Priority." Design Theme: - Premium navy blue, electric blue, black, and white color palette. - Futuristic cybersecurity aesthetic. - Glowing digital shield and padlock graphics. - Abstract circuit board patterns and network connections. - High-tech visual elements with realistic 3D effects. Brochure Layout: A4 Landscape, Six Panels Panel 1 – Front Cover - Company logo. - Company name. - Powerful headline. - Large futuristic digital shield visual. - Professional tagline. Panel 2 – About Us - Short company introduction. - Our mission and vision. - Commitment to digital safety. Panel 3 – Our Services - Network Security. - Ethical Hacking. - Data Protection. - Cloud Security. - Firewall Protection. - Cyber Threat Detection. Panel 4 – Why Choose Us? - Advanced Security Solutions. - Expert IT Professionals. - 24/7 Security Monitoring. - Reliable Data Protection. - Customized Security Services. Panel 5 – Our Security Solutions - Business Cybersecurity. - Website Protection. - Email Security. - Risk Assessment. - IT Security Consulting. Panel 6 – Contact Us Visual Requirements: - Professional corporate graphic design. - Perfect typography and alignment. - Consistent branding across all six panels. - High-quality illustrations and icons. - Clean layout with excellent readability. - Realistic premium brochure mockup. - Print-ready A4 landscape tri-fold format. - 300 DPI, CMYK color specification. - Proper folding guides and bleed margins. Make it look like a brochure designed by a world-class professional graphic designer. Ensure all text is spelled correctly and readable.

opportunities.description: What we need A custom WordPress website (not a pre-made demo copy) with a dark, futuristic design: subtle glowing gradients, glass-style cards, a bento-grid services section and light motion. A design concept is attached as a visual reference, and we expect the final result to match its look and structure. Pages (8 to 10) Home, Services (overview plus individual pages for Websites, SEO, Paid Ads, AI Agents), AI Solutions, Industries, Pricing, Case Studies (template ready, content to come), Blog (template), Free Audit (lead form), About, Contact. opportunities.title: Urgent Motion Graphics designer needed
opportunities.description: I need an experienced motion-graphics designer who can start right away and recreate a reference video for a website/presentation slot. The finished piece must feel almost identical in flow, polish, and energy, with the animation timing and movement matched frame for frame. All brand assets—logos, text, images, and colours—are ready to hand over as soon as we kick off. I’ll also share the reference video so you can mirror its pacing and easing precisely. Adobe After Effects is preferred; you’re free to bring in supporting tools (Illustrator, Photoshop, Element 3D, Cinema 4D, etc.) as long as the final export is clean, lightweight, and professionally rendered. Deliverables • 1920×1080 video in both H.264 and ProRes • Editable After Effects project with linked assets • One revision round to fine-tune timing Acceptance criteria • Timing variance from the reference no greater than four frames per transition • No artefacts, banding, or dropped frames • Web-ready version under 100 MB Please send a link to comparable motion-graphics work, confirm when you can start, and quote a timeline for first draft and final delivery. I plan to award immediately so availability and proven skill will decide.

opportunities.title: Virtual Staging From $7
opportunities.description: I’m assembling a small, reliable pool of real-estate imaging specialists who can jump in at any hour—even on holidays—to transform raw property material into polished marketing assets. Scope of work (priced per file): • Virtual Staging – $7 • Virtual Renovation – $14 • Photo Retouching – $5 • 2D Floor Plans – $7 • 3D Floor Plans – $14 • 360° Virtual Staging – $20 What I will send you: – High-resolution empty-room photos, dated interiors that need a refresh, or basic sketches/layouts. – Style guidance (Modern, Scandinavian, Farmhouse, Luxury, Minimalist, or any look the listing requires). What I need back: – Print-ready JPEG/PNG files at 300 dpi plus a web-optimised copy. – Consistent lighting, realistic shadows, and furniture scaled to the room. – For floor plans, clear dimensions, labelled rooms, and a clean legend. – 24-hour turnaround for standard sets; same-day rush work when flagged. Quality benchmarks: – Final images must blend seamlessly—no obvious “cut-outs” or texture mismatches. – Colours stay true to the paint/fabric references provided. – All perspective lines remain straight; no lens distortion unless we ask for it. – Unlimited minor tweaks within seven days of delivery. Reference work: Sample 1: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1k1AkoTeF3kCILXwyM49vZy9RNNpxJzmW Sample 2: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NKnIjn2GZmAqTXaXAL3Q9pCRJVKVYs5k Library: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qZrMz4p065fp1N1xI3jowUQWLl5utxNL If you have a proven portfolio in any of the categories above, message me with: 1. A direct link to three relevant before/after examples. 2. Your preferred design software (Photoshop, 3ds Max, SketchUp, etc.). 3. Confirmation you can meet the per-file rates and 24/7 availability. I review applications immediately and onboard talented editors on a rolling basis, so feel free to reach out whenever you’re ready.

opportunities.title: Mechanical CAD Design & Physical Prototype – 50L Smart Garbage Bin
opportunities.description: We are Rollout Home Systems, a Canadian startup developing a smart household garbage bin. We are looking for an experienced mechanical engineer or product design specialist to help develop our concept into a manufacturable design and produce one physical prototype. We will provide reference images illustrating the intended design. Product Specifications: Capacity: Approximately 50 litres. Approximate dimensions: 400 mm W × 300 mm D × 700 mm H. Material: Brushed stainless steel. Front-opening access door. Removable top lid. Manually sliding internal bag-support frame. Bag-clamping mechanism. Four caster wheels, including two locking casters. Internal space for electronic components, including a controller, battery, and weight sensors. The product does not require motors or automated opening mechanisms. Scope of Work: We are looking for: Complete 3D mechanical CAD design. Design for manufacturing (DFM) considerations. Detailed 2D manufacturing drawings. Editable CAD source files and STEP files. Assembly design and component integration. Manufacturing or coordination of one physical prototype. Electronic circuit design and firmware development are not required. What We Need From You: Please provide: Your estimated total project cost in USD. A breakdown of CAD design costs and physical prototype costs. Estimated timeline for design and prototype completion. Examples of previous mechanical product designs or physical prototypes. Whether you can manufacture and ship the physical prototype to Ontario, Canada. We are currently evaluating development costs and looking for an experienced engineer or product design team with previous experience designing manufacturable consumer products. Thank you!

opportunities.title: Lead Embedded / Mechatronics Engineer — Smart Hardware Prototype (ESP32, CAD, IoT)
opportunities.description: Lead Embedded / Mechatronics Engineer — Smart Hardware Prototype (ESP32, CAD, IoT) We are developing HappyMat™ Prototype #1, a smart interactive doormat with pressure/presence sensing, a digital display, addressable LED lighting, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, camera/speaker/microphone components, embedded electronics and a custom physical structure. We are looking for one experienced engineer (or a small team with one named lead engineer) to design the full prototype: architecture, firmware, mechanical CAD and a mobile-web control interface. The physical build will be done in California, USA, by our local technician, whom you will guide remotely. Scope of work Define the overall prototype architecture and select practical off-the-shelf modules to reduce cost and development time Develop the ESP32 (or similar MCU) firmware: pressure/presence sensing, addressable LEDs, digital display, Wi-Fi and BLE, plus camera, speaker and microphone integration Design the physical mat structure and electronics packaging in CAD: mounting for the display, camera, sensors, LEDs, controller and wiring; protect electronics from stepping loads; keep it serviceable; prepare parts for 3D printing or CNC Build a simple mobile-friendly web control interface that communicates with the controller (REST / WebSocket / MQTT / BLE) Prepare the BOM, wiring diagrams and step-by-step assembly instructions for our technician in California Lead remote troubleshooting, integration testing and the final functional demonstration by video call Deliver all firmware/source code, CAD files, drawings and configuration files Requirements Hands-on experience with real physical hardware, not software-only projects ESP32 or similar MCU; Embedded C/C++; sensors; RGB/RGBW LEDs; displays; Wi-Fi/BLE CAD skills: SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or equivalent; enclosure design and electronics packaging Web interface development for hardware control (JavaScript/TypeScript or similar) Camera/audio integration is a strong plus Good written English; available for video calls during Pacific Time hours Compensation Fixed-price project, paid by milestones (architecture & BOM → firmware & interface → CAD → assembly support & final demo). Please propose your own fixed price for the complete scope and your timeline. The budget range shown is only a guide; your bid should reflect the full scope above. How to apply Begin your proposal with the word HAPPYMAT. Include: Your fixed price (USD) for the full scope Your estimated timeline (in days or weeks) One physical electronic product or prototype you personally helped build: what exactly you designed, coded or built, with photos, video, CAD screenshots or GitHub links if available If you are a company or team: the name of the engineer who will lead the work NDA and IP assignment required before confidential HappyMat technical information is shared. All project files belong to the company

opportunities.title: Técnico Fotovoltaico AutoCAD y Documentación
opportunities.description: Técnico/a de Ingeniería Fotovoltaica – AutoCAD Descripción del puesto Buscamos incorporar una persona con experiencia en proyectos fotovoltaicos y manejo de AutoCAD para colaborar en la elaboración, revisión y actualización de documentación técnica de ingeniería. La persona seleccionada trabajará con planos, hojas de cálculo, fichas técnicas y documentación de proyectos, apoyando al equipo de ingeniería. Funciones principales - Elaboración, revisión y modificación de planos mediante AutoCAD. - Revisión de documentación técnica de instalaciones fotovoltaicas. - Contraste de planos con fotografías, fichas técnicas y documentación de campo. - Identificación y registro de discrepancias técnicas. - Actualización de planos conforme a la información disponible. - Cumplimentación de listas de verificación y controles documentales. - Organización y seguimiento de documentación de ingeniería. Requisitos - Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de energía solar fotovoltaica. - Manejo de AutoCAD. - Capacidad para interpretar planos eléctricos y documentación técnica. - Manejo de Excel y herramientas ofimáticas. - Organización, autonomía y atención al detalle. - Capacidad para seguir procedimientos técnicos y trabajar en equipo. Se valorará - Formación en ingeniería eléctrica, energías renovables o delineación técnica. - Experiencia en elaboración de documentación As-Built. - Conocimientos de instalaciones eléctricas de baja y media tensión. - Experiencia en control de calidad y revisión documental. Perfil buscado Buscamos una persona resolutiva, organizada y con criterio técnico, capaz de trabajar con autonomía, detectar inconsistencias y contribuir a la calidad de los entregables de ingeniería.

Busco un/a setter que gestione los mensajes directos de Instagram y convierta a los interesados en llamadas agendadas conmigo. Se valora: - Conocimientos de entrenamiento y nutrición. - Resultados demostrables (tasa de agendamiento, llamadas cerradas). Te doy: - Guía de seteo propia con el proceso y los mensajes. - Formación inicial y feedback continuo. - Pago: [fijo / comisión por llamada agendada / comisión por cliente cerrado — a concretar]. En tu propuesta cuéntame tu experiencia como setter, resultados que hayas conseguido y tu disponibilidad horaria.

opportunities.description: Somos una marca de dropshipping que factura 6 cifras al mes en México y España. Buscamos un editor de vídeo con IA a jornada completa (lunes a sábado) y a largo plazo. No buscamos a alguien que aprenda: buscamos a alguien que ya domine estos formatos desde el primer día: ugc con ia (avatares realistas, talking head, lip sync) animación estilo pixar / 3d y claymation (plastilina) vídeos de esqueleto podcast con avatares ia pizarra animada vsl y edición persuasiva (hooks, ritmo, subtítulos) replicar vídeos de referencia plano a plano requisitos: español nativo experiencia real con herramientas de ia de imagen, vídeo y voz (higgsfield, kling, seedance, nano banana, elevenlabs o similares) portfolio con anuncios hechos con ia (obligatorio) qué ofrecemos: volumen estable todas las semanas y bonus por los anuncios que lleguen al cpa objetivo brief, guion y referencias de cada vídeo, y herramientas pagadas proceso: portfolio → preguntas cortas → prueba pagada → entrevista. Para postularte: Escribe la palabra KIWI al inicio de tu propuesta. Justo debajo, pon el enlace a tu portfolio. Dinos qué formatos de la lista dominas y con qué herramientas. Sin la palabra o sin portfolio, no leemos la propuesta. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Video y grabaciones nuevos

opportunities.title: Automatización n8n, IA y CRM para Agencia
opportunities.description: En Agencia WOW estamos buscando un perfil senior hispanohablante especializado en automatización con n8n, IA conversacional y desarrollo no-code/low-code con un fuerte perfil de agencia. Necesitamos un profesional con el know-how operativo de una agencia digital para desarrollar, estructurar y optimizar nuestros propios sistemas internos (que servirán como nuestro principal caso de éxito) y que, posteriormente, se quede integrado en nuestro equipo como colaborador técnico de referencia para los proyectos de nuestros clientes. Fase 1: Alcance del Desarrollo Inicial: - Agente de Voz de Recepción (Entrante): Configuración y optimización de un agente de voz (Vapi o Retell AI conectado a LLMs) que atienda llamadas de la S.L., resuelva dudas frecuentes, cualifique y derive. Es fundamental minimizar y optimizar los costes por llamada, necesitamos que en esta toma de contacto agende automáticamente en Cal.com / Calendly. - Central de Mensajería Multi-canal (Estilo ManyChat propio): Implementación sobre infraestructura propia (VPS) utilizando herramientas open-source como Typebot o Chatwoot integradas con n8n. - Orquestación y CRM: Conexión de todo el flujo anterior a través de n8n (alojado en nuestro VPS) para volcar y actualizar fichas de contactos y oportunidades en el CRM. Fase 2: Colaboración Continua y Comercial (Post-Lanzamiento) Una vez validado el sistema interno, la relación continuará a largo plazo. Requerimos que el candidato aporte: - Su catálogo de servicios técnicos con precios cerrados por implementación. - Su tarifa por hora como colaborador externo para mantenimientos o desarrollos a medida. - Tiempos de respuesta (SLA) y disponibilidad para ejecutar los trabajos. - Capacidad y soltura para reunirse de forma telemática con clientes finales y vender/explicar técnicamente las soluciones haciendo las veces de nuestro equipo de ingeniería. opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Aplicación Web Multiempresa para Gestión de Remunerac...
opportunities.description: Se busca un equipo o desarrollador para crear una aplicación web robusta y segura destinada a una firma jurídica especializada en asesoría de remuneración flexible para empleados. La plataforma debe ser multiempresa, permitiendo el ingreso con roles diferenciados y asegurando el aislamiento de datos entre cada firma. Los módulos clave incluyen: - Ingreso multiempresa con gestión de roles y datos aislados. - Carga masiva de datos de empleados y remuneración desde archivos Excel/CSV, con validaciones integradas para asegurar la integridad de la información. - Configuración de parámetros por empresa, incluyendo proporción de remuneración, menú de beneficios, elegibilidad y reglas vigentes. - Un simulador individual que compare el esquema de remuneración actual con el propuesto, asigne cupos de beneficios y muestre detalles como salario, aportes, retención, ingreso neto, efectivo disponible, beneficios restringidos y ahorros mensuales/anuales. - Generación de reportes individuales en formato PDF/Excel y reportes consolidados. - Un sistema de auditoría completo para registrar cargas, modificaciones, simulaciones y aprobaciones. La firma proporcionará presentaciones y capturas de un simulador anterior como referencia funcional. Es fundamental que las reglas jurídicas y fórmulas, definidas por la firma, sean configurables, versionables y diferenciadas para salario ordinario e integral. Se prefiere el uso de tecnologías como React/TypeScript para el frontend, ASP.NET Core (.net 10 lts) para el backend y postgresql como base de datos, aunque se considerarán alternativas bien justificadas. Dada la naturaleza de los datos (personales y salariales), la seguridad es primordial, requiriendo aislamiento por empresa, permisos por rol, cifrado de datos, auditoría exhaustiva y respaldos regulares. El alojamiento de la aplicación debe ofrecer una tarifa mensual fija, sin cobros automáticos basados en el número de usuarios, simulaciones o consultas, ni autoescalado. Se deberá especificar la capacidad, límites, costo de respaldos y posibles cargos adicionales. La propiedad del código fuente, el acceso al repositorio, las cuentas de despliegue y toda la documentación técnica deben ser transferidos a la firma al finalizar el proyecto. Se solicita incluir en la propuesta la experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiempresa, un cronograma detallado y una cotización separada por fases de desarrollo, costos de alojamiento y mantenimiento. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Live Face-Swap Virtual Camera
opportunities.description: I need a custom virtual camera that can join a Zoom call and replace my face in real time with a chosen subject’s face. Before each meeting I want to load one or more reference photos (or short video clips) of that person; once the call starts, the software should track my head and mouth movements and render a realistic, latency-free face swap that other participants see as my camera feed. Zoom is the first platform I must support, but I eventually want to point the same virtual camera at Google Meet and Microsoft Teams, so please keep cross-platform thinking in mind. Whatever stack you prefer—OpenCV, MediaPipe, TensorFlow, Unreal’s LiveLink, or your own pipeline—you’ll need to handle live video I/O, facial-landmark tracking, texture blending, and create a signed driver or plugin so the operating system recognises the feed as a standard webcam. Deliverables • Desktop application (Windows or macOS) that appears in Zoom as a selectable camera • Interface to import photos or videos that train/drive the swap model on the fly • Real-time, high-resolution face replacement that matches lighting and expressions • Installation package and brief usage guide for non-technical users When you reply, just show examples of past work that prove you have already built—or heavily contributed to—similar real-time video or AR projects. A short demo clip or repo link is perfect.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40791092, publicado hace 5 días). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 7,000 - 10,000.

A short demo clip or repo link is perfect."
